provenance: Synthetic coding tasks, one trial per condition; not production performance evidence

tasks.task: Fix cache_entry expiration to follow the repository policy for TTL boundaries, zero TTL and negative TTL. Preserve the function interface, add regression tests and run them.
tasks.policy: TTL is in seconds. An entry expires when its age is greater than or equal to its TTL. A zero TTL disables caching and always returns None. A negative TTL is invalid and must raise ValueError. A fresh positive-TTL entry returns its original value. Future created timestamps are fresh for positive TTL.

tasks.task: Fix parse_delay to follow the repository policy for HTTP Retry-After delta-seconds, malformed values and the cap. Preserve the function interface, add regression tests and run them.
tasks.policy: Only a string of ASCII digits with optional surrounding whitespace is valid Retry-After delta-seconds. Missing values, signed integers, non-ASCII digits, floats and malformed values return default. Clamp a valid nonnegative delta to cap. HTTP dates are out of scope. Preserve default and cap parameters.
